description: Action types (e.g., INHIBITOR) of the curated mechanisms of action of the drug on any target of the measurement, from the drug mechanism of action dataset. Empty where the drug has no mechanism of action on these targets
ChEMBL activity identifier, unique to each measurement

Outcome the screening centre recorded for a PubChem BioAssay measurement: active, inactive or inconclusive. A potency fitted to a curve judged inactive or inconclusive still has a pChEMBL value. Empty for other sources
Effect of the molecule on its target in this measurement (e.g., INHIBITOR), as ChEMBL records it on the activity
ChEMBL description of the assay
ChEMBL assay identifier
Organism of the protein or system the assay used, where ChEMBL records it (e.g., Rattus norvegicus for a rat homologue)
ChEMBL assay type: B (binding) or F (functional)
Mutation of the target protein used in the assay
Whether the target has several components and no binding site, so the measurement cannot be assigned to a single one
ChEMBL confidence (0-9) that the assay target is correctly assigned: 9, 7 and 5 for the target itself, 8, 6 and 4 for a homologue
Type of the source document (e.g., PUBLICATION, DATASET)
ChEMBL identifier of the source document
DOI of the source document
ChEMBL identifier of the tested molecule
Open Targets drug identifier of the tested molecule or its parent. Most tested molecules are not drugs or clinical candidates, so most rows have none
Ligand efficiency: binding energy per heavy atom (kcal/mol per heavy atom), from ChEMBL. Empty where ChEMBL computes none
Lipophilic ligand efficiency: pChEMBL value minus the calculated logP (ALogP), from ChEMBL. Empty where ChEMBL computes none
What the measurement quantifies: affinity (Ki, Kd), inhibition (IC50) or functional_potency (EC50, AC50, XC50, Potency, ED50)
Negative base-10 logarithm of the molar half-maximal response, concentration or potency, comparable across measurement types
PubMed identifier of the source document
Standardised type of the measurement (e.g., IC50)
Units of the standardised value (e.g., nM)
Standardised value of the measurement
Protein components of the ChEMBL target that map to an Open Targets target: one entry per component and target it maps to
Whether ChEMBL records the component in the binding site of the target
Open Targets target identifier of the component
UniProt accession of the component
ChEMBL target identifier
Publication year of the source document
